If you are a genuine animal lover, do not buy an axolotl from this place.

We picked up my baby girl from this shop in 2023 with very low knowledge of what was necessary to keep an axolotl alive. Fortunately, I do well with a steep learning curve — but now that I know what I know, I am painfully aware of how predatory this shop’s behavior was.

I was sold a “kit” that included a tank 20 gallon long tank (too small for an adult axie), and given several buckets of tank water with the promise that it would be enough to cycle the tank. *SPOILER ALERT* it was NOT. What followed was several months of pain and suffering for me and my axolotl. We struggled until I was finally able to upgrade to a proper sized tank (at least 29 gallons/axie is the recommendation — my tank is 55 gallons) and learned enough about the nitrogen cycle to know what I had originally been told was absolute BS.

None of it really mattered though, as the husbandry of their axolotls is so poor (aka these sweet babies are super inbred). We spent thousands of dollars on surgery to remove a tumor that popped up a year and a half in (we’re talking surgery done with tools meant for a normal animal’s eye), but it just came back a year later. These kind of issues are almost definitely due to bad breeding practices — and all the research I’ve done over the past three years makes me think that whoever they’re getting their axie stock from is just letting them all breed willy nilly — which is terrible, considering that most of the species can be sourced back to less than 10 “purebreds” (meaning you can’t just let them breed at your whimsy because INBREEDING.)

If you are looking to get an axolotl, 1) do your research FIRST 2) get a tank that is at LEAST 30 gallons 3) cycle your tank BEFORE purchasing!!!!! 4) do NOT add any rocks or small decorations that are smaller than the length/width of your axolotl’s head (they eat like Kirby — all suction, no thought/consideration of what they are suctioning) 5) GET A CHILLER (aka a device that cools the water — they need it around 63 F consistently) 6) get it from anywhere other than here.

I had such a great experience with their aquarium service that I have to write a review. They manage the fish tank at one of my favorite boba shops, and recently I noticed the tank wasn’t looking too good—the lighting seemed off, and the fish just didn’t look like their usual happy selves. I reached out to the shop, and they immediately gave me the owner’s contact so I could let him know.

He responded right away, was incredibly kind, and explained they were already addressing the issue. When I went back the very next day, the difference was unbelievable. They had fixed the lighting problem and even installed an automatic lighting timer so the tank would stay consistent going forward. The fish looked amazing—super active, and genuinely happy—and they even added a few upgraded touches to make the environment better for them.

I honestly can’t say enough good things about this place. The attention to detail, the owner’s fast response time, and the level of care they show is truly impressive. Highly recommend!
